name: agent-orch
description: Stage-first orchestration with bounded Windows lifecycle arguments, runtime project identity, audited coordinator registration, shared workspace limits, recommended routes and independent review.

interface.shortDescription: Bind project identity and supervise reviewed, bounded workspaces.
interface.longDescription: Keep large Git preservation lists out of process arguments and give environment reviewers compact references to complete on-disk audit evidence. Bind execution to the original project, register necessary coordinator copies through audited reconciliation and share workspace limits. Recommend current model routes, supervise bounded Worker upgrades and quota-only review fallback, independently accept exact changes, then commit and retire worktrees. Preserve model routes, unrelated edits and historical evidence; inspect activity in the local Auditor. Hooks do not wake idle chats.
defaultPrompt: Recommend current stage models, let me use, edit or customize the matrix, and initialize Git policies while preserving existing changes.
Implement and independently review this task, then finalize its exact local commit and safely retire its worktree while preserving unrelated edits.
Integrate accepted parallel task results, independently review and accept the combined patch, then commit and clean up.
